While Poisoned, the target may not roll Determination.
note: Effect starts with the Drukhari Poisons section rule (p.393).

effect:

note: Effect starts with the Drukhari Poisons section rule (p.393).

name: Liquid Agony
effect:
These upgrades may be used on any DRUKHARI weapon with the Fleshbane trait or with the Inflict (Poisoned X), applying an additional effect upon any target who suffers one or more wounds from the weapon. This adds the Inflict (Poisoned 3) trait to the weapon, if it does not already have that trait or a better version, and applies a specific effect determined by the poison.

note: Effect starts with the Drukhari Poisons section rule (p.393).

name: Nerveshard
effect:
These upgrades may be used on any DRUKHARI weapon with the Fleshbane trait or with the Inflict (Poisoned X), applying an additional effect upon any target who suffers one or more wounds from the weapon. note: Effect starts with the Drukhari Poisons section rule (p.393).

name: Nightmare Philtre
effect:
These upgrades may be used on any DRUKHARI weapon with the Fleshbane trait or with the Inflict (Poisoned X), applying an additional effect upon any target who suffers one or more wounds from the weapon. This adds the Inflict (Poisoned 3) trait to the weapon, if it does not already have that trait or a better version, and applies a specific effect determined by the poison.
The target is filled with dread while Poisoned; the character is under the effects of Terror while Poisoned and they cannot recover from Terror until after the Poisoned effect is ended. Ork characters become Frenzied instead, while Adeptus Astartes and Primaris Astartes characters are completely unaffected by this poison.
note: Effect starts with the Drukhari Poisons section rule (p.393).

name: Sanguine Exodus
effect:
These upgrades may be used on any DRUKHARI weapon with the Fleshbane trait or with the Inflict (Poisoned X), applying an additional effect upon any target who suffers one or more wounds from the weapon. note: Effect starts with the Drukhari Poisons section rule (p.393).

name: Shattergift
effect:
These upgrades may be used on any DRUKHARI weapon with the Fleshbane trait or with the Inflict (Poisoned X), applying an additional effect upon any target who suffers one or more wounds from the weapon. note: Effect starts with the Drukhari Poisons section rule (p.393).

name: Vitae Rebellion
effect:

This adds the Inflict (Poisoned 3) trait to the weapon, if it does not already have that trait or a better version, and applies a specific effect determined by the poison.
At the start of the victim’s first turn after suffering the Poisoned condition, if they fail the Toughness test to shake off the effects then they suffer enough Mortal Wounds to exceed their Max Wounds by 1, then they immediately suffer a Traumatic Injury and begin Dying.
note: Effect starts with the Drukhari Poisons section rule (p.393).
